source: V60 Precision Experience plus V61 refinements
design_summary: Dense animated starfield on all page routes, with bright glints, drift, reduced-motion and hidden-tab handling.
Transparent section wrappers and independent translucent cards; dark graphite default and a separate porcelain light theme.
More transparent theme-aware header and expanded orbital visual composition on desktop homepage.
Full headline remains in the static document; no delayed headline text reveal is required.
Five independent demo routes preserve individual identities and add a direct return to Demo Studio.
DVNM Bot offers six spoken topics, browser voice selection, volume control, speech boundary mouth movement and chest illumination.
